en.title: Out-of-Spec Breath
en.premise: A world where a citizen's 'value' is determined by their respiration and heart rate. Emotional surges are branded as 'impurities' and punished, while an optimized silence is enforced upon all. A young heart-rate administrator discovers a 'broken sword' in a waste sector, awakening impulses that defy quantification. Boarding the 'Final Train' to the furthest reaches of this managed society, he sets out in pursuit of a forbidden breath.

zh.title: 规格外的呼吸
zh.premise: 在这个世界，市民的“价值”由呼吸频率和心跳数决定。情感的波动被视为“杂质”而遭到处罚，所有人都被强制处于一种经过优化的静谧之中。一名心拍管理官青年在废弃区捡到了一把“折断的剑”，由此觉醒了无法被数值化的冲动。他搭上了前往管理社会最尽头的“最终列车”，追寻那禁忌的呼吸。
